text: [FINANCIAL RESULTS] HDFC Bank reported 8% year-over-year loan growth in Q1 FY26, up from 7% in FY25, signaling early reacceleration. Q1 deposits rose 16% year-on-year while advances grew 8%, lowering the credit-deposit ratio from 110% to 95%. Asset quality remains strong, with retail GNPA (ex-agri) steady at 82 basis points; gross NPA reported at 1.15% and capital adequacy at 19.7% in related full-year coverage. [MARGIN / RISK] Net interest margin (NIM) declined as expected, reflecting faster repricing of assets (loans) compared to liabilities (deposits) -- roughly 70% of assets are floating-rate while deposits are largely fixed, so recent rate cuts created a margin headwind. Management expects stabilization over coming quarters. Despite the NIM decline, return on assets (ROA) remained stable around 1.9% due to cost efficiencies and lower credit costs -- a mitigating factor explicitly offsetting the margin pressure. text: [FINANCIAL RESULTS] TCS reported Q1 FY26 revenue of INR 63,437 crore, up 1.3% year-on-year but down 3.3% sequentially, reflecting demand softness and the BSNL contract wind-down -- an explicit, named revenue headwind. In dollar terms revenue was $7,421 million, down 1.1% year-on-year. Operating margin expanded to 24.5% (up 30 basis points quarter-on-quarter) despite the revenue decline. Net profit was INR 12,760 crore, up 4% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 20.1%. [DEMAND OUTLOOK / RISK] Total contract value (TCV) dropped to $9.4 billion in Q1, down 22.95% from $12.2 billion in Q4 -- a significant sequential deal-signing decline flagged as a demand-side risk. Attrition rate was 13.8% (last twelve months), the highest in nearly two years -- an explicit workforce-stability risk signal. CEO & MD K Krithivasan: "The continued global macro-economic and geo-political uncertainties caused a demand contraction." Management remains optimistic about international growth for FY2026 citing the $9.4 billion order book, but noted continued delays in discretionary spend and project starts -- a mixed near-term-caution/medium-term-confidence framing.
